Title: Data Scientist (Masters)
Description: Data Scientist (Masters) — AI Data Trainer About The Role What if your expertise in machine learning, statistical inference, and data engineering could directly shape how the world's most advanced AI models think and reason? We're looking for data scientists with graduate-level training to challenge, audit, and refine cutting-edge AI systems — exposing their blind spots and helping build models that are sharper, more rigorous, and genuinely trustworthy. This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No prior AI industry experience required — just deep domain knowledge and a passion for getting things right. Organization: Alignerr Type: Hourly Contract Location: Remote Commitment: 10–40 hours/week What You'll Do Design Complex Challenges: Craft advanced data science problems spanning hyperparameter optimization, Bayesian inference, cross-validation strategies, dimensionality reduction, and more — pushing AI models to their limits Author Ground-Truth Solutions: Develop rigorous, step-by-step technical solutions including Python/R scripts, SQL queries, and mathematical derivations that serve as the benchmark for AI responses Audit AI-Generated Code: Evaluate AI outputs using libraries like Scikit-Learn, PyTorch, and TensorFlow — assessing technical accuracy, efficiency, and best practices Refine AI Reasoning: Identify and document logical failures such as data leakage, overfitting, and improper handling of imbalanced datasets, then provide structured feedback that improves how models reason through problems Who You Are Currently pursuing or holding a Master's or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a quantitative field with a strong data analysis focus Solid foundational knowledge across supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning, big data technologies (Spark/Hadoop), or NLP Able to communicate complex algorithmic and statistical concepts clearly and precisely in writing Naturally meticulous — you catch errors in code syntax, mathematical notation, and statistical conclusions that others miss No prior AI or data annotation experience required Nice to Have Experience with data annotation, data quality pipelines, or evaluation systems Familiarity with production-level data science workflows — MLOps, CI/CD for models, model monitoring Hands-on experience with experiment tracking tools (e.g., MLflow, Weights & Biases) Why Join Us Work directly with industry-leading AI research labs on frontier models Fully remote and asynchronous — work when and where it suits you Flexible contractor arrangement with high autonomy and global reach Apply your graduate-level expertise to work that has real, measurable impact on AI development Potential for ongoing contracts and expanded project access as new work launches

Title: Growth Marketing Analyst
Description: Súmate a Vemo y activa el cambio con nosotros. ¿Quiénes somos? En Vemo somos un ecosistema integral de electromovilidad. Conectamos tecnología, infraestructura y personas para hacer posible una mejor forma de movernos. Nos mueve hacer que más personas y empresas puedan dar el paso hacia la movilidad eléctrica. Todos los días integramos soluciones y acompañamiento para resolver los retos de esa transición, con las personas al centro de lo que construimos. Y queremos que seas parte. ¿Qué buscamos? Un perfil analítico con mentalidad de negocio, capaz de ligar las métricas de growth con los resultados de cada unidad de negocio. Buscamos a alguien que construya la atribución de punta a punta, automatice todo reporte manual y aplique IA para que el equipo escale. ¿Cuál será tu misión? Ser el motor analítico y de automatización de Growth. Convertirás datos dispersos de ads, web y CRM en un sistema que optimice hacia las etapas clave del funnel, no solo hacia leads. Tus principales responsabilidades serán: Construir la atribución full-funnel uniendo Meta, Google, GA4 y Microsoft Dynamics 365, y calcular unit economics por línea de negocio y canal. Analizar funnels de ciclo largo por cohorte y diseñar experimentos con rigor estadístico para encontrar fugas y oportunidades de negocio. Automatizar, junto con BI, los pipelines de datos y los reportes recurrentes de Growth, incluyendo alertas sobre KPIs clave. Implementar offline conversions en Meta y Google Ads para que los algoritmos optimicen hacia clientes reales. Ser dueño/a del catálogo de métricas de Growth y reconciliar las cifras entre plataformas para que cada número sea trazable. Aplicar IA con agentes y flujos de LLMs para automatizar análisis, detectar anomalías y analizar información no estructurada del CRM y WhatsApp. Requisitos básicos: 1 a 3 años de experiencia en growth analytics, revenue ops, BI o data analytics SQL avanzado: joins complejos, window functions, CTEs y modelado de tablas Python para análisis de datos, consumo de APIs y scripts programados Dominio de unit economics y análisis de cohortes en funnels de ciclo largo Experiencia diseñando y dimensionando experimentos Experiencia real usando LLMs para automatizar análisis o procesos Dashboards en Looker Studio, Power BI o similar Deseable experiencia en compañías de alto crecimiento: tech, movilidad, fintech o leasing. Habilidades clave: Mentalidad de negocio : traduces métricas en impacto económico. Comunicación ejecutiva : explicas a dirección qué pasó, por qué y qué hacer, sin jerga técnica. Proactividad : encuentras oportunidades que nadie te pidió buscar. Rigor analítico : tus conclusiones se sostienen con datos y método. Colaboración : trabajas de la mano con Paid Media, CRM, Comercial, BI, Producto y Negocio. ¿Por qué Vemo? El cambio lo activamos en equipo, y tu talento puede llevarnos más lejos. En Vemo, cada persona aporta experiencias, ideas y perspectivas que nos ayudan a resolver retos y construir mejores soluciones. Aquí queremos que puedas ser tú, compartir lo que sabes y descubrir nuevas formas de crecer. Promovemos un entorno de respeto, inclusión e igualdad de oportunidades. Valoramos a quienes se suman al equipo por sus habilidades y experiencia, sin discriminación por origen, raza, religión, nacionalidad, género, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad o cualquier otra condición. Trae tus ideas, suma tu talento y crece con nosotros.

Built on deep domain expertise and design thinking, Intellect’s solutions span core banking, transaction banking, payments, cash management, treasury & capital markets, risk & compliance, wealth management and AI-driven data platforms. For more information, visit 🌐 www.intellectdesign.com 🌐 www.emach.ai 🌐 www.purplefabric.ai Job Title: Automation Tester Location: Mexico City, MX Employment Type: Full-time Role Objective About the role We’re looking for an AI Engineer to build and deploy AI-powered solutions and products that solve real business problems. You’ll turn ideas into reliable production systems, working across model selection, data pipelines, application development, evaluation, and monitoring. You’ll partner with product managers, software engineers, and domain experts to define what success looks like and build solutions that meet expectations for quality, speed, cost, privacy, and security. What you’ll do - Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered applications and services, from early prototypes through production. - Integrate large language models and other machine learning models into products using APIs, open-source frameworks, and cloud infrastructure. - Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, including document ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, and response generation. - Develop tool-calling and agentic workflows where they offer a clear advantage over simpler approaches. - Create evaluation datasets and automated tests to measure accuracy, relevance, robustness, and task completion. - Improve system performance by optimizing latency, inference costs, retrieval quality, and model behavior. - Build and maintain APIs, data pipelines, and integrations with internal and third-party systems. - Implement safeguards for sensitive data, access controls, prompt injection, and unreliable model outputs. - Monitor production systems, investigate failures, and continuously improve reliability and user experience. - Document technical decisions and communicate capabilities, limitations, and tradeoffs to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. What you’ll bring - Experience building and shipping production software, with hands-on work on AI or machine learning applications. - Strong Python skills and experience developing APIs and backend services. - Practical experience working with LLM APIs or deploying open-source models. - Understanding of embeddings, vector search, RAG, prompt design, and model evaluation. - Experience with databases, data processing, Git, automated testing, and CI/CD. - Familiarity with a cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, along with containerization tools such as Docker. - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance experimentation with maintainable engineering. - Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate across disciplines. - A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have - Experience fine-tuning models or applying parameter-efficient adaptation techniques. - Familiarity with model serving, inference optimization, GPU workloads, or MLOps tooling. - Experience with multimodal AI, natural language processing, recommendation systems, or computer vision. - Knowledge of AI security, privacy, governance, and responsible development practices. - Contributions to open-source projects or a portfolio of deployed AI applications. What success looks like - AI features solve clearly defined user problems and meet agreed-upon evaluation criteria. - Production systems are observable, maintainable, and reliable. - Improvements are supported by measurable gains in quality, efficiency, or user outcomes. - Technical decisions reflect thoughtful tradeoffs not simply the newest tools or models
